scope: Read-only stability measurement on frozen f9247fe8 harness and unchanged v4 node; no AEAD promotion, no production source or default change, not a performance improvement
resource_formulas: Select per-process AVAILABLE samples by original node PID and CPU boundary UTC markers, wholly inside drive; process_start_utc must be consistent. CPU core rate = cumulative CPU counter delta / corresponding sampled wall span, approximately one-core occupancy, not scheduler wait duration or useful-work saturation. Per-thread CPU sums use adjacent observed same-TID nondecreasing counters; births/exits between samples are not reconstructed. CPU counter units100ns. Sampled private/working peaks are lower bounds; OS lifetime peak is not per-load private peak. Diagnostic percentiles use sorted floor((n-1)*p).
